page.overview:
Who is Aucasaurus?

(meaning "Auca lizard") is an extinct genus of theropod dinosaur that lived in Argentina during the Late Cretaceous period. It belonged to the family of Abelisauridae, which also included relatives such as Carnotaurus (it was a close relative to it), Majungasaurus, Rajasaurus, Skorpiovenator and Viavenator.

Aucasaurus was featured in the Jurassic Park Institute now available to browse on Dinopedia.

Aucasaurus was among the dinosaurs that were added to the Jurassic World: Rebirth update.

Aucasaurus is mentioned in the Jurassic World Dinosaur Field Guide as being an enemy to the Abelisaurus, another abelisaurid.
